healthQuestion.reason: Pinned upstream image config has no Healthcheck; ECS task definition omitted healthCheck. UNKNOWN observations are not evidence about baked healthchecks.

scopeNotes: UID/GID, capability masks, NoNewPrivs and resource.getrlimit are per-process observations. Python RLIM_INFINITY is -1; limit arrays are [soft,hard].

Only cgroup v1 is mounted. Cgroup mount roots are the container leaf /ecs/<task>/<container>; ancestor task cgroup CPU/memory/pids limits are outside the visible mount roots and were not read. Unlimited-looking leaf values do not prove absence of task/VM enforcement.
Task definition and DescribeTasks report 256 CPU / 512 MiB; these are control-plane configuration, not independently measured enforced bounds. No load/exhaustion test was run.
/proc/meminfo describes the kernel-visible environment, not an enforced task memory limit; MemTotal=921128 kB must not be treated as the configured 512 MiB limit.
Filesystem capacities are statvfs observations of mounted / and /tmp, not exclusive user-writable capacity guarantees.
Image Healthcheck is absent in verified immutable upstream config; the image-defined healthcheck question was intentionally omitted. No ECS healthCheck was configured.
